spec.title: Database Models
spec.description: SQLAlchemy models for the Rezynt application database. Includes models for users, resumes, and chat messages.

model.name: User
model.description: User account model with authentication, subscription data, onboarding information, and resume data stored as JSONB

feature.name: Resume JSONB Storage
feature.description: Resume data is stored as JSONB in User table for simplified structure
feature.implementation: - resume_data field in User model (JSONB, not null, default {}) - Each user has one resume stored as JSON document - Structure includes: personal_info, professional_summary, skills, work_experience, education, languages_spoken, awards - Personal info contains nested contacts object with email, phone, social media links - No separate tables for resume components - Flexible schema allows for easy additions/modifications

feature.name: Temporary File Storage
feature.description: Temporary storage for uploaded resume files before user registration
feature.implementation: - TempResumeFile model stores uploaded files temporarily - Files are stored on disk with UUID-based filenames - TTL-based expiration (24 hours default) - Can be linked to user after registration - Used for landing page uploads without authentication

feature.name: User Onboarding
feature.description: Track user onboarding completion and store onboarding responses
feature.implementation: - has_completed_onboarding field in User model (Boolean, default false) - onboarding_responses field in User model (JSON, nullable) - Used to show onboarding flow to new users after email verification - Stores user preferences for personalization - Prevents showing onboarding multiple times
